verdict.rationale: Teams' own platform documents building agents that users chat with inside Teams, bots that initiate and participate in conversations, agent features such as slash commands and message streaming, and Outgoing Webhooks that relay channel messages to a web service. That establishes a first-party agent-in-conversation capability. However, the evidence never explicitly shows installing an agent as a channel member or that it responds when @mentioned. missing for 10: explicit documentation of adding an agent/bot to a channel, @mention-triggered participation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
